evidence.scope: Bounded read-only Plan, six known smoke sessions and retained build/session enumeration

assumptions: The 60-minute allowance is lifetime and never renews.
Measured terminal session seconds are deduplicated elapsed time, not verified charged minutes.
Retained history cannot establish deleted, expired or other-account-user usage.
The known subtotal excludes unresolved or conflicting sessions; missing measurements are not zero.
An infrastructure smoke does not measure the complete installed-phone offline matrix.
Monthly dates are first-of-month 09:17 UTC; GitHub scheduling can be delayed.
Unknown sufficient quota blocks devices while the scheduled report remains enabled.

policy.decisionSource: Owner chat: use a directional best guess for BrowserStack balance and record the method, even if the estimate is wrong.
policy.method: 60 lifetime minutes minus deduplicated observed terminal session seconds; assume zero unobserved starting usage and estimate one charged second per elapsed second. This is not a provider-verified balance.

Safety reserve and outstanding reservation holds reduce spendable estimated credit.
A completed uncertain allocation retains its unused hold; a missing receipt leaves a pending reservation.
Capability count/calendar assume one full reservation per future monthly date and no other use; they do not predict successful offline-matrix runs.
Only a newly created reservation durably committed by the caller can authorize a capability allocation.
